understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem (+) by navigating horizontally and using gravity to fall through successive sections without landing on hazards.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT shifted the player horizontally, after which gravity automatically carried the player to the landing position. Gravity was DOWN toward smaller y-values. CLICK removed targeted breakable blocks (x) and could open fall paths; it normally did not move the player, though removing a supporting/blocking tile could cause an immediate fall. Spikes caused failure, safe tiles supported landing, and UNDO reverted the previous action.
